content:
The Sludge Works is named after the pumping machines that surround a filthy pond. The Blood Eagles have taken control of the area in 2103 and began using the sludge pumps to cultivate the sludge. The Blood Eagles created several types of sludge drinks ranging from hard and gooey to sweet and melty sludge from this extracted sludge and would develop commerce around the purchasing of quarts of sludge to consume.[1]

Arranged in a semi-circle with an outward-facing defensive wall, the location is well fortified, with a locked Safe and Beckett's belongings on the northern end, and minor Raider-themed loot scattered throughout. The Raiders have set up a bar of sorts labeled as the "Sludge Bar" across from cages bearing a "dumass storig" sign.
